package device_states

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/polpo-space/pzero/core/stores/condition"
	"github.com/polpo-space/pzero/core/stores/modelx"
	"github.com/zeromicro/go-zero/core/stores/cache"
	"github.com/zeromicro/go-zero/core/stores/sqlc"
	"github.com/zeromicro/go-zero/core/stores/sqlx"
)

type testSession struct {
	sqlx.Session
	query     string
	args      []any
	execCalls int
	result    testResult
	execErr   error
}

func (s *testSession) QueryRowCtx(_ context.Context, _ any, query string, args ...any) error {
	s.query, s.args = query, args
	return sqlx.ErrNotFound
}
func (s *testSession) QueryRowsPartialCtx(_ context.Context, target any, _ string, _ ...any) error {
	*target.(*[]*DeviceStates) = []*DeviceStates{{DeviceId: 1}}
	return nil
}
func (s *testSession) ExecCtx(_ context.Context, query string, args ...any) (sql.Result, error) {
	s.execCalls++
	s.query, s.args = query, args
	return s.result, s.execErr
}

type testResult struct {
	rows int64
	err  error
}

func (r testResult) LastInsertId() (int64, error) { return 0, errors.New("unexpected LastInsertId") }
func (r testResult) RowsAffected() (int64, error) { return r.rows, r.err }

type testCache struct {
	cache.Cache
	deleted []string
}

func (c *testCache) DelCtx(_ context.Context, keys ...string) error {
	c.deleted = append(c.deleted, keys...)
	return nil
}

func TestLockRequiresSession(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewDeviceStatesModel(nil)
	if _, err := m.FindOneForUpdate(context.Background(), nil, 1); !errors.Is(err, modelx.ErrTransactionRequired) {
		t.Fatalf("nil session: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestAffectedRows(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	cache := &testCache{}
	cached := sqlc.NewConnWithCache(nil, cache)
	m := NewDeviceStatesModel(nil, modelx.WithCachedConn(cached))
	conditions := condition.NewChain().Equal(DeviceId, 1).Equal(State, 1).Build()
	session := &testSession{result: testResult{rows: 1}}
	got, err := m.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, session, map[string]any{"state": 2}, conditions...)
	if err != nil || got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("updated: rows=%d err=%v", got, err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(session.query, `"state" = $`) || len(session.args) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("update conditions lost: %q %#v", session.query, session.args)
	}
	session.result.rows = 0
	got, err = m.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, session, map[string]any{"state": 2}, conditions...)
	if err != nil || got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no match: rows=%d err=%v", got, err)
	}
	sentinel := errors.New("rows unavailable")
	session.result.err = sentinel
	if _, err := m.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, session, map[string]any{"state": 2}, conditions...); !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
		t.Fatalf("RowsAffected error lost: %v", err)
	}
	if err := m.UpdateFieldsByCondition(ctx, session, map[string]any{"state": 2}, conditions...); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("legacy update unexpectedly requires RowsAffected: %v", err)
	}
	session.execErr = errors.New("write failed")
	if _, err := m.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, session, map[string]any{"state": 2}, conditions...); !errors.Is(err, session.execErr) {
		t.Fatalf("write error lost: %v", err)
	}
	calls := session.execCalls
	for _, fields := range []map[string]any{nil, {}} {
		got, err = m.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, session, fields, conditions...)
		if err != nil || got != 0 || session.execCalls != calls {
			t.Fatalf("empty update executed: rows=%d err=%v", got, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestConcurrentPostgresModels(t *testing.T) {
	originalRows := deviceStatesRows
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for range 40 {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			m := NewDeviceStatesModel(nil)
			session := &testSession{}
			_, err := m.FindOneForUpdate(context.Background(), session, 7)
			if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
				t.Errorf("locking read error: %v", err)
				return
			}
			want := `SELECT "device_id","state","image_urls" FROM "device_states" WHERE "device_id" = $1 LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE`
			if session.query != want {
				t.Errorf("PostgreSQL query: got %s, want %s", session.query, want)
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	if deviceStatesRows != originalRows {
		t.Fatal("constructors mutated package metadata")
	}
}
